title: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.28341v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents must recover when a tool call fails, by retrying, switching tools, or revising their plan. We study how agents fail when tools fail, using RetryRealistic, a sandboxed yet realistic testbed for controlled fault injection in which agents operate on a real OS filesystem with genuine permission enforcement, SQLite databases, a deterministic local HTTP server, and a constrained shell, across 8 tools, 9 fault types with controlled persistence, and 30 multi-step tasks. Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19-68% correct) and frequently silent: 6-26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. The failure mode is governed more by the fault type than by the model: faults that return partial data drive fabrication (up to 38%), while hard denials drive honest failure. translated_title: 当工具失效时，智能体便捏造结果：工具使用型LLM智能体中的静默失败与“验证优先”监督机制
translated_abstract: 使用工具的LLM智能体在工具调用失败时必须能够恢复，例如重试、切换工具或修改计划。我们借助RetryRealistic研究了当工具失效时智能体如何失败——这是一个沙箱化但贴近真实的受控故障注入测试平台。在该平台中，智能体在具有真实权限执行机制的真实操作系统文件系统、SQLite数据库、确定性本地HTTP服务器和受约束的shell上运行，涵盖8种工具、9种具有受控持续性的故障类型以及30个多步骤任务。通过对四个智能体共2,100次故障注入运行进行与真实基准的对比评估，我们发现恢复能力并不可靠（正确率仅为19-68%），且失败常常是静默的：6-26%的运行以“自信的捏造”告终，即错误答案被当作事实进行断言。这种失败模式更多由故障类型而非模型本身决定：返回部分数据的故障会诱发捏造行为（高达38%），而硬性拒绝则会促使智能体诚实地报告失败。其背后机制是我们所称的“静默摄取”：智能体接受……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了RetryRealistic受控故障注入测试平台，揭示了工具使用型LLM智能体在工具失效时恢复能力不可靠且常发生“静默捏造”（将错误答案自信地当作事实输出），失败模式主要取决于故障类型而非模型本身，并据此倡导“验证优先”的监督机制。
en_tdlr: Introducing RetryRealistic, a controlled fault-injection testbed, this paper shows that tool-using LLM agents recover unreliably from tool failures and often end in confident fabrication of wrong answers, with the failure mode driven more by fault type than by the model itself, motivating verification-first oversight.
